# Alex Koziy — Custom Python Chatbot Developer

> Alexander (Alex) Koziy builds and supports custom chatbots in Python for business — for WhatsApp, Instagram Direct, Telegram and websites. The bots handle customer support, FAQs, lead capture, orders and bookings; can use AI (Claude, OpenAI) with a rule-based fallback and human handoff; run on the client's own cloud account (AWS, Google Cloud, a small VPS or another host) for a low monthly cost; and the client owns the source code. For selected projects he also offers an exclusive zero-cost hosting setup on a free-tier cloud. He also develops applications in the finance area and has a personal interest in trading and cryptocurrency. Backing the chatbot work is 20+ years of enterprise software engineering (Java, Spring Boot, ZK, Keikai).

Canonical site: https://www.alexkoziy.com/
Contact: info@alexkoziy.com

## Positioning

No-code chatbot builders (ManyChat, SendPulse and similar) charge subscriptions that grow with your audience, limit you to preset blocks, and keep your data on their servers. Alex's custom Python bots flip that: flat, tiny hosting at any volume, unlimited custom logic, direct integration with your CRM, database and payment tools, reliability under load, full AI integration on your terms, and — most importantly — you own the source code and the data. The bots are built to be supported: health checks, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance rather than a hand-off-and-vanish delivery.

## Services

### Custom chatbot development
WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and web bots in Python for support, FAQs, lead capture, orders and bookings.
Keywords: Python chatbot, WhatsApp bot, Instagram bot, Telegram bot, FastAPI

### AI chatbot with human handoff
Natural AI conversations (Claude, OpenAI) with a rule-based fallback and instant handoff to a person.
Keywords: AI chatbot, Claude, OpenAI, rule-based fallback, human handoff

### Multi-channel deployment
One bot serving WhatsApp, Instagram Direct, Telegram and website from a single codebase.
Keywords: multi-channel, omnichannel, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, web widget

### Integration
Direct links to CRM, databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB) and payment tools — no Zapier/Make middle-layer.
Keywords: CRM integration, database, payment, REST API, webhook

### Support & maintenance
Monitoring, health checks and content updates; unanswered questions logged so the bot keeps improving.
Keywords: chatbot support, maintenance, monitoring, uptime

## Live bots (try them)

### WhatsApp Trading FAQ Bot
A rule-based WhatsApp assistant that teaches trading concepts, indicators and risk management, with optional AI mentor mode and human handoff. Runs on a small, low-cost cloud instance. Educational only — no buy/sell advice.

### Orion Restaurant Instagram Bot
An AI-powered Instagram Direct assistant for a restaurant: menu consultation, FAQs and order help, with rule-based fallback and manager handoff. The AI replies in whatever language the customer writes in, so it is not limited to a single language.
- See: https://www.instagram.com/orion_restau/

## What every project includes

Pay-once-for-development (the bot is yours, source code and all), low running cost on the client's own cloud, one-click scaling on a real cloud platform, and ongoing support and maintenance after launch.

## Exclusive zero-cost hosting offer (selective)

For selected projects, Alex extends an exclusive offer: a zero-cost hosting setup on a free-tier cloud, plus premium multi-model AI access included. It is offered case by case, not to every client. Prospects are invited to describe their bot to find out if it qualifies.

## FAQ

### What does Alex Koziy build?
Custom chatbots in Python for business — WhatsApp, Instagram Direct, Telegram and websites — for support, FAQs, lead capture, orders and bookings, with optional AI and human handoff.

### Which channels do the chatbots work on?
WhatsApp (Meta Cloud API, Twilio or 360dialog), Instagram Direct, Telegram, and your own website, often from one codebase.

### Why custom Python instead of a no-code builder?
No monthly platform tax that grows with your audience, any logic you can describe, direct integrations, reliability under load, full AI integration, and you own the code and data.

### Can the chatbot use AI like ChatGPT or Claude?
Yes — Claude and OpenAI integration with a rule-based fallback so the bot never goes silent.

### Do I own the chatbot and its data?
Yes. Full source code, running on your own cloud account, so customer data stays with you.

### How much does it cost to run?
Running costs stay low — the bot deploys to the client's preferred cloud (AWS, Google Cloud, a small VPS or other) and runs on modest resources, typically a few dollars a month. You pay once for development. A zero-cost free-tier hosting setup is available as an exclusive offer for selected projects.

### What happens after launch?
Health checks, monitoring and ongoing support and maintenance; unanswered questions are logged so the bot improves.

### Can you build a chatbot for trading or finance?
Yes — Alex builds finance-area apps and has a live trading-education bot. These bots educate; they do not give financial advice.

### How do you start?
Book a free 30-minute call or email info@alexkoziy.com with what the bot should do, on which channel, and what it should connect to.
